slides.title: The Error Surface
slides.caption: z=f(x,y)=x^2+y^2
slides.narration: Imagine error as height. At every horizontal location x and y, the bowl assigns the height z equal to x squared plus y squared.

slides.title: The Minimum
slides.caption: f(0,0)=0^2+0^2=0
slides.narration: Squares cannot be negative, so their sum cannot be below zero. The bowl reaches its minimum at the origin, where the surface point is zero, zero, zero.

slides.title: The Uphill Direction
slides.caption: \nabla f(x,y)=\begin{bmatrix}2x\\2y\end{bmatrix}
slides.narration: The gradient collects the two partial derivatives. It points in the horizontal direction where the surface rises most rapidly, away from the origin on this bowl.

slides.title: Reverse the Arrow
slides.caption: -\nabla f(x,y)=\begin{bmatrix}-2x\\-2y\end{bmatrix}
slides.narration: The gradient points uphill. Reversing it gives the negative gradient, which points toward the lower part of the bowl. This is the direction gradient descent follows.

slides.title: The Update Rule
slides.caption: \begin{aligned}x_{k+1}&=x_k-\eta(2x_k),\\y_{k+1}&=y_k-\eta(2y_k).\end{aligned}
slides.narration: At each step, keep the current point, subtract a scaled gradient, and use the result as the next horizontal position. The learning rate eta controls the step size.

slides.title: Choose the Step Size
slides.caption: \begin{aligned}x_{k+1}&=x_k-0.2(2x_k)=0.6x_k,\\y_{k+1}&=y_k-0.2(2y_k)=0.6y_k.\end{aligned}
slides.narration: With learning rate zero point two, each coordinate is multiplied by zero point six. The point moves closer to the origin without oscillating across it.

slides.title: The First Step
slides.caption: (x_1,y_1)=(1.8,1.2),\qquad z_1=4.68
slides.narration: Start at horizontal coordinates three, two, where the error is thirteen. Multiplying both coordinates by zero point six moves the point to one point eight, one point two, where the error is four point six eight.

slides.title: A Descending Trajectory
slides.caption: z_k=x_k^2+y_k^2
slides.narration: Repeat the same update. The coordinates and the error shrink at every displayed step as the point heads toward the center.

slides.title: Why the Error Shrinks
slides.caption: z_{k+1}=0.36z_k
slides.narration: Both coordinates are multiplied by zero point six, so their squares are multiplied by zero point three six. Therefore the error is multiplied by zero point three six at every step and approaches zero.

slides.title: Final Result
slides.caption: \boxed{(x_k,y_k)\longrightarrow(0,0),\qquad z_k=x_k^2+y_k^2\longrightarrow0}
slides.narration: Starting from three, two with learning rate zero point two, the iterates approach the minimum at zero, zero, zero, and the error approaches zero because each coordinate is multiplied by zero point six.

from manim import *
import numpy as np

class GeneratedScene(ThreeDScene):
    def construct(self):
        self.set_camera_orientation(phi=65 * DEGREES, theta=-55 * DEGREES, zoom=0.82)

        axes = ThreeDAxes(
            x_range=[-0.5, 3.5, 1],
            y_range=[-0.5, 2.5, 1],
            z_range=[0, 14, 2],
            x_length=5.4,
            y_length=4.6,
            z_length=4.8,
        )
        axis_labels = axes.get_axis_labels(
            x_label=MathTex("x", font_size=40),
            y_label=MathTex("y", font_size=40),
            z_label=MathTex("z", font_size=40),
        )

        bowl = Surface(
            lambda u, v: axes.c2p(u, v, u**2 + v**2),
            u_range=[-0.05, 3.15],
            v_range=[-0.05, 2.15],
            resolution=(24, 20),
            fill_opacity=0.62,
            checkerboard_colors=[BLUE_D, BLUE_E],
            stroke_color=BLUE_B,
            stroke_width=0.5,
        )

        title = MathTex(r"z=x^2+y^2", font_size=38, color=BLUE_C)
        rule = MathTex(
            r"(x,y)\leftarrow(x,y)-\eta\nabla f(x,y)",
            font_size=28,
        )
        eta = MathTex(r"\eta=0.2", font_size=32, color=YELLOW)
        direction = MathTex(
            r"-\nabla f\;\text{points downhill}",
            font_size=25,
            color=GREEN_C,
        )
        panel = VGroup(title, rule, eta, direction).arrange(
            DOWN,
            aligned_edge=LEFT,
            buff=0.28,
        )
        panel.to_corner(UR, buff=0.45)
        self.add_fixed_in_frame_mobjects(panel)

        values = [
            np.array([3.0, 2.0, 13.0]),
            np.array([1.8, 1.2, 4.68]),
            np.array([1.08, 0.72, 1.6848]),
            np.array([0.648, 0.432, 0.606528]),
            np.array([0.3888, 0.2592, 0.21835008]),
            np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.0]),
        ]
        scene_values = [axes.c2p(*point) for point in values]

        start_dot = Dot3D(scene_values[0], radius=0.12, color=YELLOW)
        start_label = MathTex(r"(3,2,13)", font_size=32, color=YELLOW)
        start_label.move_to(axes.c2p(2.45, 2.15, 13.5))

        min_dot = Dot3D(scene_values[-1], radius=0.1, color=RED)
        min_label = MathTex(r"\min=(0,0,0)", font_size=32, color=RED)
        min_label.move_to(axes.c2p(0.3, 0.35, 0.8))

        segments = [
            Line3D(
                scene_values[i],
                scene_values[i + 1],
                thickness=0.035,
                color=YELLOW,
            )
            for i in range(5)
        ]
        arrows = [
            Arrow3D(
                scene_values[i],
                scene_values[i + 1],
                color=GREEN_C,
                thickness=0.035,
                height=0.18,
                base_radius=0.055,
            )
            for i in range(5)
        ]

        moving_dot = Dot3D(scene_values[0], radius=0.14, color=ORANGE)
        iter_label = MathTex(r"k=0", font_size=32, color=ORANGE)
        iter_label.move_to(axes.c2p(2.25, 0.2, 11.2))

        self.play(
            Create(axes),
            Create(axis_labels),
            FadeIn(bowl),
            FadeIn(panel),
            run_time=2.2,
        )
        self.wait(0.8)

        self.play(
            FadeIn(start_dot),
            FadeIn(start_label),
            FadeIn(min_dot),
            FadeIn(min_label),
            FadeIn(moving_dot),
            FadeIn(iter_label),
            run_time=1.2,
        )
        self.wait(0.7)

        self.play(
            Create(segments[0]),
            Create(arrows[0]),
            moving_dot.animate.move_to(scene_values[1]),
            Transform(
                iter_label,
                MathTex(r"k=1", font_size=32, color=ORANGE).move_to(
                    iter_label.get_center()
                ),
            ),
            run_time=1.8,
        )

        self.play(
            Create(segments[1]),
            Create(arrows[1]),
            moving_dot.animate.move_to(scene_values[2]),
            Transform(
                iter_label,
                MathTex(r"k=2", font_size=32, color=ORANGE).move_to(
                    iter_label.get_center()
                ),
            ),
            run_time=1.5,
        )

        self.play(
            Create(VGroup(*segments[2:])),
            Create(VGroup(*arrows[2:])),
            Succession(
                *[
                    moving_dot.animate.move_to(scene_values[i])
                    for i in range(3, 6)
                ],
                lag_ratio=0.05,
            ),
            Transform(
                iter_label,
                MathTex(r"k\to\infty", font_size=32, color=ORANGE).move_to(
                    iter_label.get_center()
                ),
            ),
            run_time=2.8,
        )
        self.wait(0.9)
